For decades, Karachi’s Rainbow Centre quietly supplied almost all of Pakistan with video games, movies, TV shows, and software - long before Netflix, Steam, or cheap internet existed. Today, it has a new lease on life as Pakistan’s largest video game market.

Located in Saddar Bazaar (Centre Market), the Rainbow Centre wasn’t just a gaming market. It operated as the backbone of Pakistan’s black market entertainment economy, where PlayStation games were copied overnight, Hollywood & Bollywood films appeared days after release, and entire shops survived on a legal grey line.

Today, Rainbow Centre has reinvented itself. Instead of DVDs and CDs, the focus is now firmly on video gaming - including PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X & Series S, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and PC gaming.

The market is now packed with:

• PS5, Xbox & Nintendo Switch consoles
• Console jailbreaking, mod chips
title: Inside Pakistan’s Biggest Video Game & Piracy Market 🏴‍☠️
